In the chunk below, we used the [robotstxt package](https://gitup.com/ropensci/robotstxt) to check if we are allowed to write a program that scrapes the page: <>
```{r}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "courses-instruction/isa/",
  domain = "https://bulletin.miamioh.edu"
)
```
